title: Artificial intelligence-enabled discovery of a RIPK3 inhibitor with neuroprotective effects in an acute glaucoma mouse model
summary: Artificial intelligence-enabled discovery of a RIPK3 inhibitor with neuroprotective effects in an acute glaucoma mouse model. Language and graph neural network models proposed RIPK3 inhibitor candidates, followed by docking and MD filtering. Candidates were checked by docking, ADMET prediction, MD, and in vitro and in vivo (acute ocular hypertension mouse) experiments. Evidence limits: Which model produced the lead and the effect size were not assessed (abstract only); mouse model only. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
ai_technology: Large language and graph neural network models for target-compound identification
